title: galium mollugo var. mixtum
intro: Galium mollugo var. mixtum, commonly known as Bugle, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Galium mollugo var. mixtum include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and treating various digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
